summary.text: Latyna Humphrey is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 15 and currently represents District 2 in the Ohio House of Representatives.
Before entering the legislature she was an author, activist and community relations professional.

paragraphs.text: Latyna Humphrey was an author, activist and community relations professional before her appointment to the Ohio House, according to Ballotpedia.
She has worked at the Franklin County Court of Common Pleas and the Franklin County Auditor's Office.
Humphrey represents District 2 in the Ohio House and assumed her current term on January 1, 2023.
In 2025–2026 she is the ranking member of the Government Oversight Committee and serves on the Community Revitalization, Energy and Public Safety committees.
She advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 15 and faces Republican Joseph Healy in the general election; there is no incumbent in the race.
